data.name: Shadowbane: Resurgence
data.detailed_description:
We’re Making a Comeback – Experience the Enhanced Shadowbane: Resurgence

Dear Adventurers of Shadowbane: Resurgence,

Thank you for your patience! The Shadowlands, a realm woven with countless epic battles and cherished memories, is on the brink of a glorious comeback. We’ve been listening closely to every one of your voices, and after painstaking polishing and all-round optimizations, Shadowbane: Resurgence is ready to return to the fray — and we invite you to embark on a new journey across the Shattered Continent with an elevated gaming experience.

Kook Community Group：39486143

QQ Group：71966411

For this comeback, we’ve rolled out core optimizations across multiple dimensions: We’ve upgraded the server architecture to greatly boost network stability and gameplay smoothness, optimized compatibility with modern hardware configurations, and bid farewell to lags and stutters, making unrestricted PVP and castle siege battles more thrilling than ever. We’ve kept all classic core gameplay intact, including the 12 unique races, free class customization, and the player-driven dynamic world; at the same time, we’ve polished PVP balance, kingdom construction and resource systems, refined every detail, and restored the pure, hardcore adventure experience you love. We stay true to our original commitment to fair play — there are no pay-to-win mechanics, and all gear and skills are obtainable exclusively in-game, making strength the sole rule on the battlefield.

Classic glory never fades, and warrior spirits are about to reignite! We will release timely updates on the server launch date, exclusive return rewards, and detailed gameplay adjustments via the Steam Community and our official communities. Stay tuned for more news.

Thank you for your enduring wait and unwavering support. For both veteran adventurers returning to the battlefield and new heroes stepping into the Shadowlands for the first time, we’ve prepared a revamped adventure arena. We look forward to reuniting with you on the Shattered Continent, fighting side by side to forge new legends!

The Shadowbane: Resurgence Development Team


Changes We Made

Shadowbane: Resurgence – Phase 1 Update Details

We have set the game’s overall mode to a seasonal system. The updates for this season are as follows:

General World Changes

The game is set to be played in single box mode.

Contract drop rates have been severely reduced.

Resource drop rates have been severely reduced.

Gold drop rates have been severely reduced.

All mobs in a strife realm have the ability to drop glass at all times.

Tree of Life maintenance has been set for every week.

Discipline droppers now spawn every 3 hours.

Any character in the nation can take a boon from any city in the nation.

Setting a store page in game. You can press “ESC” to find it. Selling game gold coins, bane circular and +40 Runes. But in game Gold, bane circular and +40 Runes also drop.

Modification and addition

Modification of PVE：

During the process of building a city, players need to upgrade the Steward and Builder first to obtain the corresponding buildings and NPC contracts.

National players are displayed as blue dots. Non - National players are displayed as green dots.

The levels of all the mobs have been marked.

Mobs with a level higher than 5 - 7 will not gain experience.

The base inventory weight has been increased by 200.

Added a “Sell All Stuffs” button for players on the vendor sale page.

Added a “Fix All Stuffs” button for players on the vendor fix page.

Mine resources are automatically stacked in the backpack.

Add the “Shift + right mouse button” shortcut keys to split mine resources

Increase the Discipline drop location page on the world map. Press “Show / Hide map information”, and you can find an option for Discipline. All the Discipline drop locations have already been marked.

New setting for hotzone:Cancel the regular hotzone alive time worldwide. We are setting up a new alive system. Every SaturdayCN 9:00 AM - 12:00 AM ( ET 9:00 PM - 12:00 PM )CN 9:00 PM - 12:00 PM ( ET 9:00 AM - 12:00 AM )All the hotzones in the world will be alive, lasting for three hours.

Modification of PVP：

Cancel the Shopkeeper's Apprentice and Thief trade skill.

Pet can’t attack the buildings any more.

Players cannot use travel skills if they are under the Team following status.

The original discipline “Duelist” has been activated. You can obtain it from a random gift box in the shopping mall.

DuelistEffect: Allows the use of a weapon in each handAvailable Races and ClassesRaces: Elf, Shade, Human, Aelfborn, IrekeiClasses: Bard, Thief, Scout, Warrior, Warlock, Ranger, Assassin

A resurrection scroll item has been added.Choose "Fully Heal" to recover 100% health. You will be resurrected on the spot after 3 seconds. This will cost 100 points. After resurrection, all skills will have completed their cooldown periods.Choose "Normal Heal" to recover 30% health. You will be resurrected on the spot after 3 seconds. This will cost 30 points. After resurrection, all skills will have completed their cooldown periods.Or you can choose Respawn, Spawn in the TOL where you belong.

R8 mobs drop bane Bane Circular with very lower drop rate. You also can buy All the bane circular from store page.

The bane war participating number is setting by defense Nation.

After set up the battle time. You can find a bane commander under the TOL. Setting the battle members.

They city Tag will be Mark on the world map after Accept the offensive challenge by Golden Color

 Guild can be subbed or desubbed if they have a bane placed on them 

 Guild can be invited members if they have a bane placed on them 

 Guild can not subbed or desubbed after the bane alive.

- Guild can not invited members after bane alive.

 


About the Game

Shadowbane: Resurgence

Shadowbane: Resurgence is an MMORPG set in a dark medieval fantasy style. Its core features include unlimited free player battles and a dynamically evolving world. This game offers you an extremely innovative experience.

On this cursed land, every choice you make can redraw the map of this continent, from establishing outposts to burning the enemy kingdom. The essence of the world will change in real-time according to your will, and power and ruins are just one step apart.

II. Races & Class System: Deeply Customizable Character Creation

(I) Race Selection: 12 Distinct Vessels of Civilization

The game features 12 unique races, each with its own lore, inherent attribute inclinations, and direct impact on class compatibility:

Humans (versatile for all classes with unrivaled adaptability); Elf (boasting unparalleled magical aptitude); Dwarf (forged from stone, ageless and incapable of reproduction, master craftsmen and fearsome defenders). Aracoix (with exceptional agility);  Minotaur (born warriors);  Shade (cursed descendants of humans,  perfect for assassination-focused classes); Half-Giants (towering over all other races, with overwhelming constitution and strength).

Irekei (red - skinned desert knights and masters of arcane arts); Centaurs (an ancient plains race, the cornerstone of cavalry tactics); Aelfborn (human - elf hybrids who bear magical runes to curb their innate madness). Nephilim (fly like the Aracoix and have an aptitude for magic). The vampire race possesses an evil power capable of devouring everything.

(II) (II) Class System: 4 Base Classes  31 Classes and 48 Discipline Classes

The class system adopts a dual-tier Core-Advanced framework, featuring 22 core classes and 48 secondary advanced classes, paired with the free allocation of over 200 attribute points and 500 skill points to achieve ultimate build diversity.

Core Classes (4 Types)

  • Mage: Centered on intelligence, it offers 8 advanced career paths, such as Channeler, Wizard, Assassin, Bard, Warlock, Fury, Necromancer and Doomsayer.

     Warrior: Focused on Strength and Constitution, it is accessible to all races and has 8 advanced paths, such as Barbarian, Crusader, Ranger, Huntress, Templar, Warrior, Warlock, and Sentinel.

     Healer: Balanced in Constitution and Spirit, it has 7 advanced paths, such as Channeler, Confessor, Crusader, Prelate, Druid, Priest, and Dommsayer.

     Ranger: Blending Agility and intelligence,  it has 8 advanced paths, such as Assassin, Barbarian, Bard, Ranger, Huntress, Scout, Thief, Nightstalker.

Discipline Classes.

       Shadowbane has 48 different deputy Discipline classes. These Discipline classes have enhanced the combativeness of the basic profession and made the gameplay more diverse.

Core Gameplay: A Survival Contest of Freedom and Brutality

Unrestricted PVP: A Power Struggle Across the Entire Map

The game’s defining feature is its world-wide unrestricted PVP system: combat can break out anywhere except a handful of safe zones, and slaying an opponent allows you to claim all their loot at will, forging a raw survival-of-the-fittest ecosystem. Every power struggle hinges entirely on team strategy and individual skill.

Dynamic World: Player-Driven Civilizational Evolution

As a pioneer of early dynamic open-world MMOs, Shadowbane empowers players to:

  • Alter Terrain: Modify the landscape and construct defensive fortifications using unique skills and items.

  • Build Kingdoms:  Establish a union city, set up functional buildings according to your own needs, and set guards to patrol the city. If a city fails to meet the demands of the union, players can freely establish multiple player cities and form an alliance nation.

  • Conquer Civilizations: Siege and destroy an enemy’s core structures to permanently erase their territorial markers and rewrite the world map itself.

May every adventurer who steps into the dark fantasy world of Shadowbane forge their own legendary tale across this broken continent. Fight fearlessly, journey with loyal allies, and savor the ultimate thrill of exploration and competition. The road ahead is long—may you cut through every obstacle in your path, and rise triumphant as the King above the Shadows!

data.short_description: A classic dark fantasy open-world MMORPG with unrestricted global PVP & a player-driven dynamic world. 12 unique races, flexible 22+48 class system. Build fortresses, conquer kingdoms, reshape the continent. Steam version supports multi-systems, no pay-to-win, hardcore fair gameplay.

content_descriptors.notes:
Characteristics of violent expressions: Non-realistic but high-intensity, including equipment drops upon character death, brief soul states, non-realistic blood splatters, and limb effects, which are in line with the combat intensity of hardcore MMOs.
Dark gothic style: Creates a sustained psychological horror atmosphere through shadows, skeletons, twisted monster designs, and 低沉 sound effects. It is not a simple artistic expression but an integral part of the game's core experience.
Target audience of the game: Mature players aged 17+, focusing on hardcore PVP and PVE challenges, with content intensity meeting the expectations of the target users.
